My work asks how investors price risks that sit outside the standard factor models —
geopolitical conflict, climate exposure, and structural shifts in resource economies.

---

## Working Papers

**What type of geopolitical risk do defense stocks hedge? A sub-index decomposition of the defense premium**  
*Ahsan Habib*  
Prepared for the CRT Young Researcher Hunt 2026.

> Defense equities are widely treated as a single hedge against "geopolitical risk," but the
> risk index itself is a composite. This paper decomposes the index into its sub-components
> to ask which specific categories of risk the defense premium actually compensates for.

<!-- [Draft](files/defense_premium.pdf) · [Slides](files/defense_slides.pdf) -->

**Climate change and the Chesapeake Bay fishery industry: An integrated ecological and economic impact assessment**  
*Ahsan Habib and Wai Yan Siu*  
Manuscript in preparation. Funded by the ODU Graduate Summer Award Program (GSAP) 2026.

> An integrated assessment linking ecological projections for the Chesapeake Bay to the
> economic outcomes of the commercial fishery that depends on it.
